content_sections.heading: About TMC Varanasi
content_sections.text: Tata Memorial Centre, Mumbai, runs Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital (HBCH) and Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Centre (MPMMCC) at Varanasi. The notice is issued by the Dean (Academics), HBCH/MPMMCC, Varanasi, and the posts are in the Department of Medical Oncology.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The total is 2 vacancies. TMC reserves the right to cancel or increase/decrease the number of advertised posts.

rows.post: Specialist Senior Resident / Senior Resident / Medical Officer
Specialist Senior Resident / Senior Resident / Medical Officer

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: All undergraduate and postgraduate degrees must be recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC). Candidates whose results are awaited may apply where applicable, but must show proof of having passed the required degree at the MCQ/Interview, or they will not be permitted to appear. Age and experience are reckoned as on 06.12.2026; the notice does not print any experience requirement. Only Indian Nationals may apply. The maximum age limit is 45 years, as on 06.12.2026, for all three posts. Relaxation is as per applicable rules. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification: D.M./ DrNB (Medical Oncology) or equivalent degree recognized by NMC
M.D./ D.N.B. (General Medicine) or equivalent postgraduate degree recognized by NMC
M.D./ D.N.B. (General Medicine/Pediatrics/Pathology) or equivalent postgraduate degree recognized by NMC

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The posts are tenure-based for a fixed period up to 31.07.2027, further extendable subject to the requirements of the centre. Senior Resident/Medical Officer may be provided shared accommodation, subject to availability. Hostel charges, wherever applicable, are deducted monthly from the stipend/salary. Selected and appointed candidates must be registered with the Uttar Pradesh Medical Council, as applicable. No TA/DA is admissible to candidates appearing for the MCQ/interview.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid online by Debit Card / Credit Card / UPI and is not refunded under any circumstances.

rows.category: SC / ST / Female / Persons with Disabilities / Ex-servicemen (1st time applying for civil post after serving any rank)

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is by an MCQ examination, which may be conducted before the interview for shortlisting, and an interview. The MCQ examination may be held before the interview for shortlisting. The Dean (Academics), HBCH/MPMMCC, Varanasi, has the discretion to decide, and that decision is final. The notice does not give marks, number of questions or duration. TMC may prescribe minimum eligibility standards or cut-off marks, including Groups/Stream/Discipline/Category-wise cut-offs, for shortlisting for the interview and for final selection after the interview. It may restrict the number of candidates called based on the number of vacancies and performance. Meeting the eligibility criteria gives no right to be called. The decision of the Director, HBCH/MPMMCC, Varanasi, is final.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TMC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the online application on the Tata Memorial Centre website: https://tmc.gov.in/postmaster/Careers . Complete the prescribed online application form in all respects; incomplete applications are rejected and no other mode is accepted. Submit a separate application for each post. Pay the Rs.300/- fee online by Debit Card / Credit Card / UPI, unless exempted. Upload the documentary evidence, including the NOC where applicable. Submit by 06.12.2026, 05.30 p.m. (IST). A hard copy of the application form need not be sent. All correspondence is by e-mail from [email protected] . Candidates must give their latest mobile number and a valid e-mail ID. TMC is not responsible for non-receipt due to submission errors, incorrect e-mail IDs or mails landing in spam/bulk folders.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Proof of date of birth Proof of qualifications Proof of experience Caste/category certificate Disability certificate No Objection Certificate (NOC), where applicable, and other relevant documents Failure to provide the required documents leads to the application being treated as incomplete and summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates currently employed with a Government or Government related organization (Central / State Government / Autonomous Body / Semi Government Organization) must get an NOC through the Head of their Institution/Department and upload it with the online application. The original NOC must be produced at the MCQ test/Interview; without it the candidate is disallowed from appearing. Applications with incorrect or false information are rejected. TMC reserves the right to reject any or all applications without assigning any reason. Any dispute is subject to the exclusive legal jurisdiction of Varanasi.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in TMC Varanasi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies in the Department of Medical Oncology: 1 for Adult Hematolymphoid and 1 for Bone Marrow Transplant, each for Specialist Senior Resident / Senior Resident / Medical Officer.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for online submission is 06.12.2026 up to 05.30 p.m. (Indian Standard Time).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Specialist Senior Resident?
faq.answer: D.M./ DrNB (Medical Oncology) or an equivalent degree recognized by NMC is required.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for Senior Resident and Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Senior Resident needs M.D./ D.N.B. (General Medicine; General Medicine/Pediatrics/Pathology for the Bone Marrow Transplant post) or an equivalent NMC-recognized postgraduate degree. Medical Officer needs an M.B.B.S. degree recognized by NMC.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years as on 06.12.2026, relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC and 10 years for PwD, as per applicable rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.300/- paid online by Debit Card / Credit Card / UPI. SC, ST, female candidates, persons with disabilities and ex-servicemen (1st time applying for a civil post after serving any rank) are exempted.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Specialist Senior Resident gets a monthly consolidated salary of Rs. 1,45,530/-, Senior Resident Rs. 1,33,623/- and Medical Officer a monthly salary of Rs. 1,11,132/-.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online through https://tmc.gov.in/postmaster/Careers; no other mode is accepted and a separate application is needed for each post.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is through an MCQ examination, which may be held before the interview for shortlisting, and an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job, and is a security deposit required?
faq.answer: No, the posts are tenure-based for a fixed period up to 31.07.2027, extendable subject to the requirements of the centre. A security deposit equal to the monthly pay of each post is applicable: Rs. 1,45,530/-, Rs. 1,33,623/- and Rs. 1,11,132/-.
